body:
OWNER PAUSE CHECKPOINT — P0 SupportAssessment successor is paused before commit so the chief can catch up.

Custody and merge plan:
- Standalone build clone: /private/tmp/storymodel4s-support-honesty
- Branch: scout/support-assessment-v4
- Immutable predecessor HEAD: c53818f6c73e0290388132996c046988136ac489 over base e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a
- Current successor is an uncommitted working-tree delta. Nothing has been copied into the shared checkout, pushed, merged, or registered as a candidate.
- The eventual route remains one narrow successor commit, exact reference-scope gate bound to that SHA, non-force branch push, then fresh immutable candidate review by the two named reviewers and chief authorization. No local merge.

Scope:
- Authorized envelope is 30 paths: the original 13 plus the approved 17-path expansion.
- Current full diff from base changes 29 paths; the mutable working-tree delta changes 28. Every changed path is reserved and within the envelope.
- No docs, sibling-type sweep, or broader cost-model provenance work was absorbed.

Implemented and previously green:
- CostBreakdown and SupportBasis are bare-private non-case checked carriers.
- LocalCostModel source and external producers are fallible and receive one explicit invocation SupportBasis.
- GraphHsmm rebuilds returned breakdowns against that basis; HsmmResult and hsmm/v4 carry the complete basis; decode requires an independent expected basis and claims internal consistency only.
- hsmm/v4 golden was regenerated; SHA-256 88d36e7e4fcfc3d28da89d3619e1f42cc4a1455ba1669b2e779ffac555b45736.
- Earlier green evidence: compileAll; JVM align 244, codec 118, fixtures 118, embed-bench 67, embed-grakern 28, laws 86.

Fresh courts and findings since that checkpoint:
- Explicit courts now cover NaN FunctionPrior, NaN/infinite external floor and mismatch, custom NaN externalCost, and the exact two finite unit terms with Double.MaxValue weights.
- A red court proved that a custom model could return Unreachable for a readable source and be silently filtered. Recall review corrected its earlier overbroad oracle: reject Unreachable only; preserve lawful Unassessable audit rows. The narrow GraphHsmm refusal is implemented, and focused CostSuite is green 20/20.
- HsmmResult remains private[align]. A same-subpackage compile probe can call its constructor and bypass validated. Chief ruling request msg-01M1DCDHB4NBTNHD5WY1DT18RG is still open. The temporary measurement court remains intentionally non-final pending yes/no.
- New source-level review finding msg-01M1DD3AY28KVRTXKZR9NNCF39 is valid and accepted for disposition: neutral Propositional and Entity 0.5 prices are currently counted as measured support when the comparison does not apply, despite AlignWire already documenting those cases as ineligible. No remedy or red court has been added. This changes per-cell eligibility and wire/result coherence, so I am pausing for chief scope/estimand direction rather than choosing silently.

Current verification state:
- Latest scoped formatting and test compilation pass.
- Focused CostSuite passes 20/20 after the readable-source Unreachable refusal.
- git diff --check is clean.
- Full JVM/JS/Native/reference-scope gates have not been rerun after the fresh courts and must be rerun only after the two open dispositions settle.

Safe resume order:
1. Chief rules on sealing HsmmResult.
2. Chief dispositions the Propositional/Entity ineligibility finding and any exact court expected.
3. Apply only those rulings, remove or flip the temporary constructor measurement, run focused and portable courts.
4. Freeze one successor commit, run exact path audit, scalafmtCheckAll, compileAll, full reference-scope JVM and affected JS/Native gates.
5. Push and register the immutable SHA for fresh reviews. No landing or closure authority is claimed.

Reservations remain held to protect the mutable slice while paused. I will not advance production code until the chief replies.
